question.question: ReFinED times its inference on the AIDA-CoNLL test set. How many documents does that test set have, how many does the whole AIDA CoNLL-YAGO dataset have, and what share of the dataset is the test set? Search the web for the dataset size.
question.answer: The test set has 231 documents (4,464 mentions). The full AIDA CoNLL-YAGO dataset has 1,393 documents, so the test set is about 16.6% of it.

key_points: The test set is about 16.6% of the dataset

The AIDA-CoNLL test set consists of 231 documents. The entire AIDA CoNLL-YAGO dataset contains a total of 2,882 documents. To find the share of the dataset that the test set represents, you can calculate it by dividing the number of documents in the test set by the total number of documents in the dataset:

\[ \text{Share} = \frac{\text{Test Documents}}{\text{Total Documents}} = \frac{231}{2882} \approx 0.0803 \]

This indicates that the test set constitutes approximately 8.03% of the total AIDA-CoNLL-YAGO dataset.
